outcome: Spontaneous preterm birth between 32-37 weeks GA
Very preterm birth between 28-32 weeks GA
cohort: The study evaluated 469 twin pregnancies in Taiwan that underwent cervical length screening between 20-24 weeks of gestation.
finding: Cervical length screening at 20-24 weeks gestation demonstrated moderate predictive potential for spontaneous preterm birth in Taiwanese twin pregnancies, with a cervical length below 20 mm suggested as an optimal cut-off.
cross-section timing: Cervical length screening performed between 20-24 weeks of gestation (average 22.7 weeks).
gest_age: Participants were screened between 20-24 weeks of gestation (average 22.7 weeks); outcomes assessed for preterm births between 28-37 weeks of gestation.
